title: 列車自動監督系統~Automatic train supervision systems
focus: 列車監督排程與旅客資訊的一致性~Consistency of train supervision scheduling and passenger information
summary: 本課聚焦列車監督排程與旅客資訊的一致性。從班距監督與瓶頸建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把旅客服務需求累積與營運異常警報排序連成可驗證的介面，最後以監督整合重播計畫整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies consistency of train supervision scheduling and passenger information. Start with headway supervision and bottlenecks to define physical or information boundaries, connect accumulation of passenger service demand with ordering operational alarms as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through supervision integration replay plan. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對列車監督排程與旅客資訊的一致性而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用時刻偏差吸收及旅客資訊一致性連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For consistency of train supervision scheduling and passenger information, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through absorbing timetable deviation and passenger-information consistency. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究班距監督與瓶頸。原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。敏感度只改 S=420 至 462 m，輸出變為 62.8 s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究時刻偏差吸收：原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元以月台占用和區間追蹤兩個資源比較班距，先找瓶頸再討論監督系統可調整的空間。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate headway supervision and bottlenecks. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. For sensitivity, change only S=420 to 462 m; the output becomes 62.8 s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate absorbing timetable deviation: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Compare platform occupation and open-line following as separate headway resources, identifying the bottleneck before considering what supervision can adjust. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 班距監督與瓶頸~Headway supervision and bottlenecks
units.title: 班距監督與瓶頸~Headway supervision and bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 本單元以月台占用和區間追蹤兩個資源比較班距，先找瓶頸再討論監督系統可調整的空間。班距是時間資源問題，不能僅用兩車車頭距離判斷。列車長度、防護距離與釋放時間會共同占用線路；車站停靠、路口衝突或折返可能比區間運轉更先成為瓶頸，所以縮小單一間隔不等於全線增能。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。~Compare platform occupation and open-line following as separate headway resources, identifying the bottleneck before considering what supervision can adjust. Headway is a time-resource problem, not merely a distance between train fronts. Train length, protected separation and release time occupy the route together. Dwell, conflicting junctions or terminal reversals can dominate capacity before open-line running does, so reducing one interval need not raise line throughput. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system.
units.verify: 以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。以「班距監督與瓶頸」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately. For headway supervision and bottlenecks, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。回到「班距監督與瓶頸」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere. Trace the input chain for headway supervision and bottlenecks. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高~Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion.
units.practice: 只把假想防護距離 S 從 420 改成 462 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 60 變為 62.8 s。先說明「班距監督與瓶頸」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only hypothetical protected distance S from 420 to 462 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 60 to 62.8 s. Explain the causal direction for headway supervision and bottlenecks, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 時刻偏差吸收~Absorbing timetable deviation
units.title: 時刻偏差吸收~Absorbing timetable deviation
units.mechanism: 本單元將提前、延誤與可用餘裕列在同一時空圖，防止同一段緩衝被多項調整重複使用。時刻表餘裕是已排間隔扣除占用與擾動後的剩餘時間。餘裕可以吸收小延誤，卻不是可隨意重複使用的免費容量；同一段緩衝若被兩個衝突約束同時借用，紙面上可行的時刻仍會在實際重播中互相追趕。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。~Place early running, delay and available margin on one time-distance diagram so several adjustments cannot silently consume the same recovery buffer. Timetable margin is scheduled separation less occupation and perturbation. It can absorb small delays but is not free capacity that may be reused indefinitely. If two conflicting constraints both claim the same buffer, a timetable that appears feasible on paper can still produce converging delays in replay. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied.
units.verify: 將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。以「時刻偏差吸收」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction. For absorbing timetable deviation, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。回到「時刻偏差吸收」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. Trace the input chain for absorbing timetable deviation. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤~The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously.
units.practice: 只把入侵延誤 delay 從 18 改成 19.8 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 12 變為 10.2 s。先說明「時刻偏差吸收」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only incoming delay delay from 18 to 19.8 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 12 to 10.2 s. Explain the causal direction for absorbing timetable deviation, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.title: 停站延長決策~Dwell-extension decisions
units.mechanism: 本單元比較延長停站接續轉乘與保持後車間距的衝突，把旅客服務目標與線路容量一起呈現。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。~Compare holding a train for connections with preserving separation from its follower, presenting passenger-service objectives alongside the route-capacity consequences. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences. Dividing by total service rate assumes an even passenger distribution, yet doors near popular stairs are often more crowded. The busiest door governs completion, so average flow cannot guarantee timely clearance at that door. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.
units.verify: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。以「停站延長決策」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. For dwell-extension decisions, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「停站延長決策」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for dwell-extension decisions. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同~Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
units.practice: 只把登車人數 N 從 180 改成 181 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30.75 變為 30.8542 s。先說明「停站延長決策」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only boarding passengers N from 180 to 181 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 30.75 to 30.8542 s. Explain the causal direction for dwell-extension decisions, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 旅客服務需求累積~Accumulation of passenger service demand
units.title: 旅客服務需求累積~Accumulation of passenger service demand
units.mechanism: 本單元以旅客請求進出服務區的模型觀察需求累積，將未服務旅客保留在資料中而非刪除。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。平均服務能力若只略高於平均需求，瞬間車潮仍會形成等待；人群不能被無限壓縮，所以排隊長度會回堵上游樓梯或月台，改變原先假設的到達方式。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。~Use passenger entry and exit from a service area to observe demand accumulation, retaining unserved travellers in the data instead of removing them. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow. Even service capacity slightly above mean demand can be overwhelmed by a train-arrival pulse. People cannot be compressed indefinitely, so a growing queue can block upstream stairs or platforms and alter the assumed arrival process. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
units.verify: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。以「旅客服務需求累積」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. For accumulation of passenger service demand, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。回到「旅客服務需求累積」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Trace the input chain for accumulation of passenger service demand. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊~Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
units.practice: 只把觀察時間 duration 從 120 改成 132 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 72 變為 79.2 persons。先說明「旅客服務需求累積」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only observation duration duration from 120 to 132 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 72 to 79.2 persons. Explain the causal direction for accumulation of passenger service demand, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 監督訊息頻寬~Supervisory message bandwidth
units.title: 監督訊息頻寬~Supervisory message bandwidth
units.mechanism: 本單元統計多列車位置與狀態更新的通訊需求，分別比較同步推送和錯開傳送造成的佇列。網路負載必須把列車數、更新頻率、封包長度及協定額外開銷一併計入。總位元率只是起點，同步突發、重送與頻道共享仍會改變排隊延遲；容量充足也不代表封包的截止時間一定可以滿足。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻持續流量，不包含加密協商、重送尖峰或介質競爭。~Account for position and status updates from many trains, comparing the queueing effects of synchronized reports with deliberately staggered transmission. Network demand includes train count, update frequency, packet length and protocol overhead. Aggregate bit rate is only a starting point because synchronized bursts, retransmissions and channel sharing affect queues. Adequate average capacity does not guarantee that every packet meets its deadline. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform sustained traffic; handshakes, retransmission bursts and medium contention are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：列車數 trains=30 trains；每次訊息大小 bytes=240 bytes；更新頻率 rate=5 Hz；協定擴張倍率 overhead=1.6 1。公式 y=trains*bytes*8*rate*overhead/1000，代入得 y=460.8 kbit/s。邊界：均勻持續流量，不包含加密協商、重送尖峰或介質競爭。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train count trains=30 trains; message size bytes=240 bytes; update frequency rate=5 Hz; protocol overhead factor overhead=1.6 1. Formula y=trains*bytes*8*rate*overhead/1000 gives y=460.8 kbit/s. Boundary: Uniform sustained traffic; handshakes, retransmission bursts and medium contention are omitted.
units.verify: 在封包擷取中核對實際線上長度，將同步與錯開更新兩種情境分別量測延遲。以「監督訊息頻寬」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Check actual wire length in packet captures and compare delay for synchronized versus staggered updates. For supervisory message bandwidth, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

units.anchor: 到發時間共同時基~Common timebase for arrivals
units.title: 到發時間共同時基~Common timebase for arrivals
units.mechanism: 本單元檢查行控紀錄和車站資訊系統是否使用一致時間，避免把時鐘漂移解讀成準點率變化。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Check whether control logs and station information share a consistent timebase, avoiding interpretation of clock drift as a change in punctuality. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.verify: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「到發時間共同時基」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For common timebase for arrivals, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「到發時間共同時基」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for common timebase for arrivals. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致~Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
units.practice: 只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「到發時間共同時基」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for common timebase for arrivals, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 營運異常警報排序~Ordering operational alarms
units.title: 營運異常警報排序~Ordering operational alarms
units.mechanism: 本單元將重複延誤警報與真正不同的設備異常分開，讓操作員看見原因鏈而非只看警報數。警報到達率描述操作員接收訊息的負荷，但嚴重度、重複性與處置時間也決定可管理性。大量同根因警報可能淹沒最早的關鍵訊息；抑制重複訊號應保留可追溯性，不能以刪掉重要警報來美化數字。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。~Separate duplicate delay alarms from distinct equipment anomalies so operators can understand the causal chain rather than merely the alarm count. Alarm arrival rate describes operator information load, while severity, repetition and action time determine manageability. Many alarms from one cause can obscure the first critical message. Duplicate suppression must preserve traceability rather than deleting important alarms to improve a metric. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。公式 y=events/minutes，代入得 y=3 alarms/min。邊界：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min. Formula y=events/minutes gives y=3 alarms/min. Boundary: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability.
units.verify: 以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。以「營運異常警報排序」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events. For ordering operational alarms, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 警報洪流可能使操作員確認了所有訊息卻未處理根因，缺乏優先順序又會延遲關鍵判斷。回到「營運異常警報排序」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~An alarm flood can lead to acknowledging messages without addressing causes; missing prioritization delays critical interpretation. Trace the input chain for ordering operational alarms. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recalculate 3 to 3.16667 alarms/min. Explain the causal direction for ordering operational alarms, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 列車任務狀態管理~Managing train-mission states
units.title: 列車任務狀態管理~Managing train-mission states
units.mechanism: 本單元列舉上線、停駛與任務交接的合法狀態，檢查同一列車是否被分配互斥任務。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Enumerate valid entry, withdrawal and assignment states, checking whether one train has accidentally been allocated mutually incompatible missions. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.verify: 用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。以「列車任務狀態管理」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states. For managing train-mission states, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Trace the input chain for managing train-mission states. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. units.title: 旅客資訊一致性~Passenger-information consistency
units.mechanism: 本單元把月台顯示、車內播報與行控排程連成案例矩陣，要求每項更新能追溯同一版本。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Connect platform displays, onboard announcements and control schedules in a case matrix, requiring each update to trace to one consistent version. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.verify: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「旅客資訊一致性」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For passenger-information consistency, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Trace the input chain for passenger-information consistency. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. units.anchor: 監督整合重播計畫~Supervision integration replay plan
units.title: 監督整合重播計畫~Supervision integration replay plan
units.mechanism: 本單元安排整日營運事件的縮時重播，將重置環境、保存證據和異常重測納入測試工時。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Plan accelerated replay of a full operating day, including environment reset, evidence preservation and anomaly reruns in the test-effort budget. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.verify: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「監督整合重播計畫」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. For supervision integration replay plan, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Trace the input chain for supervision integration replay plan. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h.
